name: YouTube Shorts Automation — AI Create & Publish (Pro)

parameters.content:
## YouTube Shorts Content Engine (Pro)

**Production-grade pipeline:** Google Sheet settings → AI script → voice + image → Creatomate → YouTube.

**Buyer setup (5 steps):**
1. Copy `content-strategy-template.csv` into Google Sheets (Settings + Usage Log tabs — see INSTALLATION-GUIDE.md)
2. Connect **Google Sheets OAuth2** on Load Settings + Append Usage Log
3. Connect **OpenAI API** on the 3 OpenAI HTTP nodes
4. Connect **Creatomate** (Header Auth: `Bearer KEY`) on Creatomate nodes
5. Connect **YouTube OAuth2** on Upload node
6. Import + activate **YouTube Shorts — Error Alerts** workflow; verify Error Workflow in this workflow's Settings

**Creatomate template elements:** `Voice-Audio`, `Background-Image`, `Hook-Text`, `Caption-Text` (1080×1920)

**No code editing required** — buyers change niche/topic/tone in the Settings sheet only.

nodes.name: Load Settings
nodes.notes: Paste your Google Sheet ID — buyers never edit n8n nodes

nodes.name: Append Usage Log
nodes.notes: Logs token usage + cost per published Short

parameters.content:
## Stage 0 — SaaS Settings
Google Sheet drives niche, tone, topic, voice, privacy, template ID. Set `active=TRUE` on one row.

## Stage 1 — Content + Cost Tracking
Hook-Body-CTA script generation with token usage logging and word-count validation.

## Stage 2 — Media
Parallel TTS voiceover + cinematic DALL-E background with cost estimates.

## Stage 3 — Render, Publish, Log
Creatomate 9:16 render → YouTube upload → Usage Log sheet. Failures trigger Error Alerts workflow.
